details:
Puppet menu is they are best suited to float values. The 2 and 4 Axis puppet make use of the sticks, and the Radial Puppet makes use of a percentage. However, neither of these menus really play well with integers in my testing, so any puppet option better suited for integers would be appreciated.
Additionally, puppet menus use the analog stick for controls, rather than the mouse, or trigger in non-flick select. Meaning the feeling of operating a puppet compared to a button is substantially different.
Not all animations are best suited for working with Float values. Float values work best when working with blendtrees, but for animations that disable or enable certain elements, A float value is only really useful for a transition into a puppet menu.
For example, I have an animation that activated when Stage1 is set to 1, putting my avatar in a 'ready mode' such as holding a gun, and then I have an animation when Stage2 is set to 1, which plays an automatic gunfire animation. Then, when Stage2 is set to 0, it goes back into 'ready mode'
Under the older button menu option, I could set a Submenu to set Stage1 to 1, and fill that submenu with a single button that sets Stage2 to 1. It would fire for as long as the trigger is held, and when released, stop firing.
This behavior no longer works since Button Behavior was changed. Regardless, the old system didn't have the same update rate, so it was never well suited for the example I provided above.
Another example of integer based puppet menu options that would be helpful is provided in the image.
Basically, a 'charge attack' animation plays for 3 seconds. If the button is released before the charge up is finished, the animation cancels and goes to its neutral state. If the button is held long enough for the charge up animation to finish, it moves to a looping 'full charge' animation and waits for the button to be released, then plays a new animation.
This worked (locally) under the older system as well, and is handy to prevent accidentally triggering larger disruptive animations.
title: [FEEDBACK] Allow Integer based puppet menus.
